title: Took a load off my mind on an important work trip to use this service
text:
This was a wonderful service, and took a load off my mind on an important work trip.  I wanted to make sure I would be able to have a driver available to take me from my hotel to a work client in the "suburbs" of Barcelona, and also to have a driver available to take me back downtown to the hotel.

The driver was there early, and while I was in my work meeting, parked nearby until I was ready to be driven back.  He was courteous and friendly, and we had a great conversation both there and back.
